Wakanda is a fictional, landlocked African country in the central mountains near Lake Turkana, surrounded by difficult terrain that helped it isolate itself from outsiders. Its inhabitants speak Xhosa. [wp-66902704-lore-p30] [wp-66902704-lore-p31]
